theater: 襄州棗陽、隨州與漢水上游

battle.name: 棗陽之戰
battle.theater: 襄州棗陽、隨州與漢水上游
battle.brief: 嘉定十年（1217）秋，蒙古自河南南下，奪棗陽、逼襄陽，荊襄告急。宋將孟珙率兵自隨州疾援，敗蒙古軍於城下，盡復失地，襄樊防線不搖。卡面的希臘火在這場戰役並無實錄：攻守靠的是弓弩、砲石與撞車，燒不出一條通路，救得了襄陽的是援軍與城防。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 交戰雙方是南宋與蒙古大汗國，但蒙古這一邊並不是一支專為攻宋而組成的部隊，而是整個大汗國兵力的南端。蒙古本部仍以千戶、百戶為骨架，草原騎兵是骨幹；可是一二一七年能投到荊襄的兵力，必須從一二一一年以來在河北、山東、中原收攏的金朝降附軍中抽取，攻城所用的砲手、匠人、雲梯隊、撞車隊多出其中。南線的軍務由木華黎經營的漢地軍政系統與其部將分頭指揮，時間上又與一二一八年蒙古攻金朝西安、鳳翔一線，以及一二一九年成吉思汗舉兵西征花剌子模互相牽動：蒙古用來對宋的兵，其實是它全部資源的一角。宋方是寧宗朝的荊襄防區，樞密院掌軍令，荊湖制置司主襄、隨、棗一線的防務，襄州、隨州、棗陽各級守臣分節抵禦，後方以江陵、鄂州兩處漕轉節點沿漢水北運糧秣，弓弩靠江南造戎院造辦，並就地募民兵與流民守城。雙方心裡都清楚對手是長敵：宋廷主和而拖延，蒙古則把攻擊當成外交施壓的延伸，邊州在兩邊手裡都是籌碼。
countriesEn: The two sides were Southern Song and the Mongol Great Khanate, but the Mongol force was not a special army raised for the siege of Song; it was the southern end of the khanate's entire military effort. The Mongol proper was still organised into thousands and hundreds, with steppe cavalry as its backbone, yet the troops that could be sent to Jingxiang in 1217 had to be drawn from the Jin troops surrendered and gathered in Hebei, Shandong and the Central Plain since 1211, and the artillery crews, carpenters, ladder parties and ram crews of the assault came mostly out of that pool. The southern line was directed by the Han Chinese affairs system under Muqali and his subordinates, and in time it interlocked with the Mongol attack on the Jin cities of Xi'an and Fengxiang in 1218 and with Genghis Khan's expedition against Khwarezm in 1219: the troops turned against Song were only a corner of the khanate's total resources. On the Song side stood the Jingxiang defence zone of Emperor Ningzong's court. The Privy Council issued the orders, the Jinghu Circuit Commission held the defence of the Xiangzhou, Suizhou and Zaoyang line, the officers of those prefectures held their several sections in turn, and behind them Jiangling and Ezhou served as the two transshipment points that moved grain north along the Han River. Bows and crossbows came from the arsenals of the Jiangnan, and militia and refugees were enrolled on the spot to man the walls. Both sides understood that the enemy was a long-term one: the Song court chose to buy time and to stall, while for the Mongols an attack was an extension of diplomatic pressure, and a border prefecture was a bargaining chip in either hand.
people: 宋方最關鍵的人物是孟珙，字璞玉，洺州人，父孟宗政。孟珙此時年紀尚輕，是隨州一線的守將，《宋史·孟珙傳》記嘉定十年蒙古犯棗陽，珙率兵赴援，孤軍入敵陣而解棗陽之圍，這是他獨當一面統兵的第一戰，役後因功升授湖北都副都統制，開始接手襄陽防務。孟宗政是隨州的老將，治軍嚴整，把歸附流民練成精騎與步卒相配的鄉兵，是一二一七年之後宋軍在荊襄唯一成形的機動力量，後來出任知襄陽府，主持城防諸事。趙方於一二一七年病逝在襄陽，臨終仍以襄樊城守為念；其子趙葵接掌荊湖安撫事，在蒙古圍城最緊的幾年裡勉力撐住防線。蒙古一方，一二一七年前後負責南線的仍是木華黎所領的漢地軍務系統，具體統率棗陽方向兵馬的將領姓名，漢文與波斯文史料都沒有定說；成吉思汗本人此時在漠北與河西之間籌備西征，並不在棗陽城下。宋廷方面，韓侂胄被殺之後改行對蒙結好、對金賄賂之策，主持者是史彌遠，荊襄守臣只能在朝議拖延與邊境實戰之間自行周旋。
peopleEn: The decisive figure on the Song side was Meng Gong, courtesy name Puyu, a native of Mingzhou, whose father was Meng Zongzheng. Meng Gong was still young and held a command in the Suizhou area; the Meng Gong biography in the Song Shi records that in the tenth year of Jiading, 1217, the Mongols struck at Zaoyang, and that Meng Gong marched to the rescue, entered the enemy position with a single command and lifted the siege of Zaoyang. It was his first battle fought on his own responsibility, and after it he was advanced to deputy commander of the Huguang circuit and began to take over the defence of Xiangyang. Meng Zongzheng was the veteran of the Suizhou line. He kept his troops tight and trained the refugees who had attached themselves to him into village troops pairing cavalry with footmen, and these were the only formed mobile force the Song had in Jingxiang after 1217; he later took up the post of prefect of Xiangyang and directed the works of the city defence. Zhao Fang died of illness at Xiangyang in 1217, still thinking of the defence of Xiang and Fan at the end; his son Zhao Kui took over the pacification commission of Jinghu and held the line together through the tightest years of the Mongol siege. On the Mongol side the southern line in and around 1217 was still run by the Han Chinese affairs system under Muqali; the names of the commanders who actually led the troops towards Zaoyang are not settled in either the Chinese or the Persian sources, and Genghis Khan himself was in the northern steppe and the Hexi corridor preparing the western expedition, not before Zaoyang. On the Song court side, after Han Tuozhou was killed the policy was reversed to befriend the Mongols and buy off the Jin, and the man directing that policy was Shi Miyuan, so the commanders in Jingxiang had to work the gap between the court's stalling and the fighting at the frontier on their own.
kits: 卡面上這件希臘火是拜占庭的東西：西元七世紀六、七十年代，一般繫於六七〇年前後，帝國為對付阿拉伯海軍而造的燃燒劑，装在銅管做成的喷射器裡，可以架在船首，也可以固定在城牆上施放，點燃後在水面仍能繼續燃燒。帝國把配方當作最高機密，配方最終隨沉船失傳，卡面那句話講的正是這件事。放到一二一七年的棗陽，必須老實講一句：這場戰役的記錄裡沒有希臘火，也沒有任何可以確指為火油噴射器的裝置。攻守雙方手上真正見於記載的，是蒙古軍的砲、撞車、雲梯與坑道，宋軍的角弓、弩（宋人稱神臂弓、麻札弩）、石砲、擂木與火箭。所以這件兵器在此戰的位置，是一條譜系上的遠祖，而不是戰場上的實物。東方的對應物是宋人《武經總要》器械篇所收的猛火油櫃，一種把燃燒劑封在櫃中、以人力拋擲或噴出的器械，宋夏交鋒時在陝西已有使用的記載；再往東，才是蒙古自伊斯蘭世界帶回中亞的攻城火攻技術，要到一二一九年西征之後才逐步東傳。希臘火的血統在一四五三年君士坦丁堡陷落時徹底斷絕，其原理卻分別活在火藥兵器與猛火油櫃兩支後代身上。
kitsEn: The Greek fire on the card is a Byzantine weapon. It belongs to the sixties and seventies of the seventh century, conventionally dated around 670, when the empire built a burning liquid against the Arab fleets: it was carried in a siphon made of copper tubing, could be mounted on a ship's prow and also fixed on a city wall, and once lit would keep burning on the surface of the water. The empire treated the formula as its highest secret, and it was finally lost with the ship that carried it, which is exactly what the sentence on the card says. Set against Zaoyang in 1217, one has to be plain about it: the record of this campaign contains no Greek fire and no device that can be identified as a projector of burning oil. What the two sides actually held, as the sources attest, was the Mongol artillery, rams, scaling ladders and mines on one side, and on the other the composite bow, the crossbow (the shenbi gong and the mazha crossbow in Song usage), stone-thrown artillery, dropping beams and fire arrows. The position of the weapon on the card in this war is therefore that of a remote ancestor on a line of descent, not an object on the field. Its eastern counterpart is the menghuoyou gui recorded in the section on equipment of the Song military manual Wujing Zongyao, a vessel in which the burning liquid was sealed for hurling or spraying by hand, with records of its use against Western Xia in Shaanxi; further east still lie the besieging fire techniques that the Mongols would carry back from Central Asia, and those spread eastward only after the expedition of 1219. The bloodline of Greek fire was cut for good when Constantinople fell in 1453, but its principle survived in two separate heirs, gunpowder ordnance and the fire-oil vessel.
tactics: 蒙古這一套打法在一二一七年已經成形：騎兵不攻城，去切斷對方的援軍與糧道，再對孤立的城邑作短時間的強攻。進攻序列是標準的蒙古式——先以輕騎巡弋外圍、封鎖道路，把隨州與襄陽之間的傳令、糧運掐斷；再在城下結營，填壕、搭雲梯、鑿地道、豎撞車，同時在壕溝對面布弩手與步卒，用定點射擊覆蓋進攻通道；破城之後並不打算長期駐防，掠獲的糧草牲畜隨即被捎走，蒙古西征在即，兵不能久滯南方。守方的宋軍則是另一套節點式的守禦：棗陽、隨州、襄陽三者互為犄角，漢水是漕運的命脈，糧食自江陵、鄂州溯流北運；城頭以弩為主、弓為輔，角弓射手在城堞後輪番壓制，弩手用重箭封住城下通道；守軍不與蒙古騎兵在野外交手，只以夜襲焚毀攻城器械與草料，待援軍到齊再出城反擊。孟珙在棗陽做的正是這一課：急行軍抵達後不急著硬碰，先偵察蒙古營寨的虛實與糧秣所在，再選其疲憊的時機出奇襲，一戰而解圍。
tacticsEn: The Mongol method had already hardened by 1217: the cavalry did not assault walls, they cut the enemy's reinforcements and supply lines, and then hit isolated towns with a short, violent attack. The sequence of assault was the standard Mongol one. Light horse first swept the perimeter and sealed the roads, strangling the dispatch and the grain traffic between Suizhou and Xiangyang; the army then encamped before the city, filled the ditch, raised scaling ladders, drove mines and stood up rams, while crossbowmen and footmen were deployed across the ditch to cover the approach with aimed fire; once the city fell there was no intention of holding it, and grain and cattle taken were carried off at once, because the western expedition was imminent and troops could not be tied down in the south for long. The Song answer was a different, nodal style of defence: Zaoyang, Suizhou and Xiangyang covered one another, the Han River was the artery of supply, and grain moved north from Jiangling and Ezhou against the current; on the walls the crossbow was the main arm and the bow the support, composite bowmen firing in turns from behind the parapet and crossbowmen sealing the path below with heavy bolts. The garrison avoided meeting the Mongol horse in open country, and instead raided at night to burn the siege gear and the fodder, waiting for reinforcements to assemble before striking out from the gate. That was the lesson Meng Gong applied at Zaoyang: after the forced march he did not rush into a frontal clash, but read the strength of the Mongol camp and where its supplies stood, waited for the moment when the enemy was tired, and took the camp by surprise, winning the field in a single action.
data: 這場戰役留下的確數不多，須把可查與不可查分開。地理上：棗陽在漢水北岸支流的流域，位於襄陽以北、隨州以西的交通缺口上，距襄陽城約近百公里，距隨州城約四五十公里，控住由河南經鄧州、襄州南下江漢的水陸轉運點；城為土築，周圍數里，外壕引水。時間上：蒙古自一二一一年起三次大舉攻金，一二一七至一二一八年為第二階段，一二一九年成吉思汗西征花剌子模；棗陽之戰正在這個窗口內，蒙古無法在此長期屯兵，約在一二一八年轉向西北攻金朝西安一線。兵力方面：史料未記棗陽一役蒙古的實數，一般攻城一次投入以數千至數萬為概略；同一條戰線上蒙古圍襄陽的兵，數目亦無定說，可確認的是圍城部隊在數千至數萬的量級，其總兵力當然遠大於此處；宋方當時在荊襄的官軍是數千人量級，援軍自隨州、江陵、鄂州調集。兵器方面：宋的弩射程遠過角弓，重型弩的有效射程約二百至三百五十公尺；蒙古攻城砲在一二一九年西征取得伊斯蘭工匠之前仍屬簡陋，多賴人力拋擲。希臘火本身的年代座標是：拜占庭在七世紀六、七十年代開始使用，一二〇四年君士坦丁堡陷落後配方失傳有傳說，一四五三年帝國滅亡後再無實物可考。
dataEn: This campaign has left few hard figures, and what can be checked must be kept apart from what cannot. On geography: Zaoyang lies in the basin of a northern tributary of the Han River, at the gap in the communications between Xiangyang to the south and Suizhou to the west, roughly a hundred kilometres north of the city of Xiangyang and some forty to fifty kilometres from the city of Suizhou, holding the road-and-river junction by which an army coming down from Henan through Dengzhou and Xiangzhou reached the middle Han and the lower river. The wall was rammed earth, some few kilometres round, with water drawn into the ditch outside. On timing: the Mongols mounted three great campaigns against Jin from 1211, the second of these ran from 1217 to 1218, and Genghis Khan marched west against Khwarezm in 1219; the battle of Zaoyang falls inside that window, and the Mongols could not leave a large force parked here for long, turning to the north-west against the Jin city of Xi'an around 1218. On numbers of men: the sources give no exact figure for the Mongol force at Zaoyang, and an assault of this kind is generally put at somewhere between several thousand and tens of thousands; the army that ringed Xiangyang on the same axis is equally unnumbered, though it can be said with confidence that the investing force lay in the range of several thousand to tens of thousands, and that the Mongol total was far greater. On the Song side the regular troops in Jingxiang were of the order of a few thousand, with reinforcements drawn from Suizhou, Jiangling and Ezhou. On arms: the Song crossbow out-ranged the composite bow, a heavy crossbow being effective at roughly two hundred to three hundred and fifty metres, while the Mongol siege artillery was still crude before the craftsmen of the Islamic world were taken in 1219 and largely worked by manpower. The date marks of Greek fire itself are these: Byzantium began to use it in the sixties and seventies of the seventh century, its formula is said to have been lost when Constantinople fell in 1204, and after the empire's end in 1453 no example of it survives in any collection.
cause: 打到棗陽的因由有三層，最外一層是宋蒙之間那筆算不清的帳。一二一一年蒙古破野狐嶺、滅金國北方之後，金廷求援於宋，宋依韓侂胄之策出兵助金，是宋金第一次聯合的北線。一二一四年滦州之盟後金朝轉而向蒙古稱臣，宋廷在一二一五年得知其事，寧宗朝在韓侂胄被殺後改弦更張，轉取對蒙結好、對金賄賂之策。成吉思汗要求南宋出兵助攻金國、共禦北敵，宋廷懼於再啟大戰，一再拖延，既不出兵也不斷絕往來。蒙古這時已在一二一六年滅了乃蠻、蔑兒乞，西面安定，正要籌備一二一九年的西征；在蒙古的算盤裡，拖延就是敵意，攻下宋的邊州可以施壓，可以取得糧草，可以切斷宋金再聯合的可能，而棗陽、襄陽一線正是宋在河南與江漢之間唯一可用的堡塞。地理上，棗陽守著漢水上游的缺口，蒙古奪下它，就等於把攻勢擺到襄陽城下。於是一二一七年秋，蒙古自河南南下，兵鋒直指棗陽、隨州與襄陽。
causeEn: There were three layers to the reason for the fighting at Zaoyang, and the outermost was an account between Song and the Mongols that could never be settled. After the Mongols broke the pass of Yehuling in 1211 and ruined the northern half of the Jin state, the Jin court begged Song for help, and Song, following the policy of Han Tuozhou, sent troops to aid Jin, forming the first northern front on which Song and Jin stood together. After the treaty of Luanzhou in 1214 the Jin turned instead to make submission to the Mongols; the Song court learned of it in 1215, and after Han Tuozhou was killed the policy of Ningzong's court was reversed, to befriend the Mongols and pay the Jin in money instead. Genghis Khan required Southern Song to raise troops and help strike at Jin so that the two would hold the northern enemy together; the Song court, afraid of opening a new great war, stalled and stalled again, neither sending troops nor breaking off relations. The Mongols had destroyed the Naiman and the Merkit in 1216 and had settled their western flank, and were now preparing the expedition of 1219. In Mongol arithmetic, delay was hostility: taking a Song border prefecture applied pressure, yielded grain and stock, and removed any possibility of a renewed Song-Jin alliance, and the line of Zaoyang and Xiangyang was the one chain of forts Song still had between Henan and the middle Han. Geographically, Zaoyang guarded the gap in the upper Han: once the Mongols held it, the offensive stood at the gates of Xiangyang. So in the autumn of 1217 the Mongol army came down from Henan with its spear pointed at Zaoyang, Suizhou and Xiangyang.
impact: 棗陽之戰的後果不寫在殘垣上，而寫在二十六年後的襄樊。一二一七年這一役是蒙古第一次把兵鋒深入南中國腹地，也是宋廷主和派無法再靠外交拖延的證明：蒙古兵來了，來得比朝議快。直接的結果是荊襄防務的地位在南方軍政中急升，趙葵、孟宗政、孟珙三代守將在襄隨一線屯兵儲糧、整修城壘、招集流民，襄陽由一座邊州變成可以久守的堡塞；孟珙經營襄陽數年，寫下專論蒙古戰法的兵書，其留下的守城思路到一二六〇年代仍在被援引，那時蒙古軍再度南下，棗陽、隨州、襄陽、樊城一線再度成為戰場。武器與技術層面的推動同樣重要：蒙古在對宋作戰中逐步收編漢地與中亞的攻城工匠，砲具、雲梯、撞車與火攻的技藝隨之傳播，希臘火所屬的那一類燃燒與噴射技術，也在蒙古西征之後由伊斯蘭世界逐步傳入中原，只是到了十三世紀中葉火藥兵器成熟的時候，希臘火的直接傳承已經斷在一四五三年之後，它留下的原理分家落戶。戰役的另一面是南宋的財政與民力：荊襄的長期屯兵、沿漢水的漕運與沿線屯田，都要從江淮與四川轉運，供養這道防線；而棗陽、襄陽這樣的邊州此後再未脫離戰爭，直到一二七三年樊城、一二七四年襄陽先後陷落，一二七九年南宋亡國。
impactEn: The consequences of the battle of Zaoyang are not written on broken walls but in the Xiang and Fan of twenty-six years later. The campaign of 1217 was the first time the Mongols carried the point of their arms deep into the belly of southern China, and the proof that the Song court's peace party could no longer hold the enemy off with diplomacy: the Mongol soldiers had come, and they came faster than the debates in the court. The immediate result was that the defence of Jingxiang rose in rank in the military administration of the south. Three generations of commanders, Zhao Kui, Meng Zongzheng and Meng Gong, held troops and stored grain on the Xiang and Su line, repaired the walls and gathered the refugees, and Xiangyang changed from a border prefecture into a fortress that could be held for a long time. Meng Gong spent years on Xiangyang and wrote a book on the way the Mongols fought; the thinking about city defence he left was still being cited in the 1260s, when the Mongol army came south again and the line of Zaoyang, Suizhou, Xiangyang and Fan became a battlefield once more. The advance in arms and technique mattered just as much: as they fought Song, the Mongols took over craftsmen from Han China and from Central Asia, and with them the skills of the artillery, the ladder, the ram and the attack by fire. The class of burning and projecting technique to which Greek fire belonged also began to travel eastward from the Islamic world after the western expedition, though by the time gunpowder ordnance matured in the middle of the thirteenth century the direct descent of Greek fire had been cut off after 1453, and its principle had split into separate heirs. The other face of the campaign was the money and the labour of the southern Song: the permanent garrison in Jingxiang, the grain traffic up the Han River and the farming on the lines of supply all drew on the Jianghuai and on Sichuan, and a border prefecture such as Zaoyang or Xiangyang never afterwards left the war, until Fan fell in 1273 and Xiangyang in 1274, and the Song was destroyed in 1279.
result: 打到嘉定十年冬，蒙古軍在棗陽城下沒有得到他們想要的結果：孟珙自隨州率兵疾進，敗其營，焚其攻城器械與草料，棗陽得全，蒙古兵退往河南方向；蒙古主力其後轉向西北，一二一八年攻金朝西安、鳳翔一線，一二一九年成吉思汗舉兵西征花剌子模，把兵力從宋境抽走，一二一七至一二一九年對襄陽的圍困亦因此解體。以當時的勝負論，宋是守住了，蒙古沒有打下荊襄，也沒有把棗陽與襄陽變成長久的據點。以長局論，這一役的結果其實寫在六十餘年後：蒙古的攻勢沒有停，一二一七年之後是一二二〇年代的數次南侵、一二三〇年代以後對兩淮、襄樊、四川的長期消耗，以及一二六七年起的襄樊攻堅；南宋靠孟珙一代建立起來的襄樊防禦體系，最終擋住了回回砲與投石機的攻城，也終於沒有守住，樊城於一二七三年、襄陽於一二七四年陷落，宋元在漢水一線的最後一場大戰由蒙古贏下。回頭看棗陽，一二一七年那幾日在棗陽城下獲勝的宋將，正是四十九年後在襄陽主持防務、把這道防線推到最高強度的孟珙；他於一二六六年病逝，樊城陷落時他已不在世上，只留下這道防線與他寫下的文字，交給後人去守。
resultEn: By the winter of the tenth year of Jiading the Mongol army had not got what it came for below the walls of Zaoyang. Meng Gong marched out of Suizhou with the speed of forced march, broke their camp, burned their siege gear and fodder, recovered Zaoyang entire, and drove the Mongols back towards Henan. The Mongol main force then turned north-west, struck at the Jin cities of Xi'an and Fengxiang in 1218, and in 1219 Genghis Khan marched west against Khwarezm, drawing the troops out of Song territory, and the siege of Xiangyang that had run from 1217 to 1219 came apart for the same reason. Judged by the result of the day, Song held: the Mongols did not take Jingxiang and did not turn Zaoyang and Xiangyang into lasting bases. Judged by the long game, the outcome of this campaign was written more than sixty years later. The Mongol pressure did not stop: after 1217 came the invasions of the 1220s, the long attrition against the Jianghuai, Xiangfan and Sichuan after 1230, and the siege of Xiang and Fan that opened in 1267. The Xiangyang defence system built by Meng Gong's generation did at last withstand the counterweight trebuchets and the stone-throwing engines, and at last did not hold either: Fan fell in 1273 and Xiangyang in 1274, and the last great battle on the Han River between Song and Yuan was won by the Mongols. Looked back at Zaoyang, the Song commander who won below its walls in 1217 was the very man who, forty-nine years later, directed the defence of Xiangyang and carried that line to its highest strength. He died of illness in 1266, before Fan fell, and left behind only the line of defence and the words he had written, to be held by those who came after.
